nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.util.hemodynamics.measure_qc¶

QC figures for stage-6 LOC cross-section measurements.

Writes a five-panel PNG (centerline indices loc±2) with complex-difference background, in-plane mask contours, and the active LOC marked — for visual review of cross_section_at_loc() placement.

Functions¶

save_loc_cross_section_qc_png(→ None)

Five-panel row: CL indices loc-2 … loc+2 with CD and mask contour each.
